topic: AI front desk workflows should create a clean queue for property managers
hook: Your AI front desk should create a clean queue, not more admin work.
captionInstagram:
Your AI front desk should create a clean queue, not more admin work.

For property managers, the goal is not to add another inbox, dashboard, or chatbot to babysit. The goal is to turn missed leasing calls, tenant intake, maintenance requests, CRM follow-up, owner updates, and vendor handoffs into clean next steps your team can trust.

That means the workflow should answer quickly, ask for the right details, route the next owner, write back to the CRM, and escalate when a human should take over.

Start with one workflow that repeats every day, costs you when it waits, follows clear rules, and can be measured within days.

slides.title: Your AI front desk should create a clean queue.
slides.body: The job is simple: answer fast, capture context, route the next step, and log what happened where your team already works.

slides.title: Every missed call needs an instant next step.
slides.body: Prospects should get a text-back, qualification questions, and a route to booking before the lead goes cold.

slides.title: Intake should arrive dispatch-ready.
slides.body: Capture unit, issue, urgency, photos, access notes, and routing details before staff chase missing information.

slides.title: Follow-up should not rely on copy-paste.
slides.body: Calls, texts, appointments, notes, tags, and next steps should land in the system your team already uses.
slides.footer: One note, one status, one next action

slides.title: Handoffs need a clear owner.
slides.body: Leasing, maintenance, owner updates, and vendor dispatch stall when no one knows who owns the next step.
slides.footer: Route exceptions before they become backlog

slides.title: Start with one workflow that proves ROI.
slides.body: Choose the workflow that is high-volume, expensive to delay, easy to route, and simple to measure.
slides.footer: Volume + delay cost + rule clarity + system fit

slides.title: Your first workflow can launch in about 7 days.

slides.footer: Built around your CRM and phone/SMS stack
